name: cinematic-web-motion-workflow-kit
description: Composable, framework-neutral skills for visual website direction, motion, browser evidence, and handoff.

skills.name: cinematic-web-motion
skills.summary: Routes a website or browser-motion task to the smallest relevant specialist skill.

skills.name: visual-story-direction
skills.summary: Defines a visible premise, hierarchy, visual material, and critique target before effects are added.

skills.name: website-motion-intake
skills.summary: Maps an existing website's stack, accepted baseline, ownership, and verification route before implementation.

skills.name: motion-choreography
skills.summary: Assigns motion lanes, transform ownership, scroll behavior, cleanup, and accessible fallback.

skills.name: browser-evidence
skills.summary: Chooses and records running-artifact browser evidence with an honest verdict.

skills.name: delivery-handoff
skills.summary: Packages scope, evidence, known issues, and next actions without exposing private material.
